record.title: Cyprus: Turkish Cypriot Limnitis crossing suspension, March–June 2020
record.scope: Limnitis–Kato Pyrgos Green Line crossing; de facto divide, not an internationally recognised interstate border
record.direction: Both directions through the specified crossing
record.exceptions: Other posts remained open under separate conditions; testing requirements applied when Limnitis reopened.
record.enforcement: June 26 report describes actual crossings and local committee/UNFICYP confirmation.
record.consequences: Local committee accounts describe lengthy commuter detours during the suspension; no aggregate impact estimate.
record.relationship: Related to GS001, but different crossing/authority and endpoint; do not count as an independent national policy.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no inference about present status
record.official_rationale: Turkish Cypriot Council of Ministers cited the coronavirus emergency.
record.context: A joint March decision included Strovilia; its endpoint is not inferred from Limnitis. Limnitis remained restricted after other posts began reopening.
record.uncertainty: March 22 was the initial planned expiry, not an observed reopening. Scope is ordinary crossing, with no claim about every exceptional passage. Exact onset hour unestablished.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure
